verdict.rationale: Stripe Tax exposes a Standalone Tax Calculations/Transactions API and a Tax Registrations API, covering core tax calculation, recording, and registration workflows that mirror Dashboard actions (stripe-tax-docs-15, -16, -18). However, several UI-centric features—nexus/registration monitoring insights, itemized/summary report exports, and no-code Payment Links tax setup—are described only as Dashboard capabilities with no documented API equivalent. Missing for 10: API access to monitoring/nexus insights, API-driven report generation/export, and confirmation that Payment Links no-code tax setup has a full API path plus independent verification of true UI/API parity.
